title: ReconRAG: Ingest-Time Version Reconciliation for Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Evolving Regulations (Code and Benchmark Dataset)
description: Official reproducibility package and public benchmark dataset for ReconRAG: Ingest-Time Version Reconciliation for Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Evolving Regulations. Includes 57 Indonesian ministerial regulation pairs (1,199 amendment provisions with deterministic gold labels and 444 full-replacement provisions with three-model silver labels), 418 rule-validated benchmark questions, 5,852 graded model answers, and the complete Python implementation of the three-layer reconciliation cascade and evaluation suite.
